resources.string: Your last bump (number %1$d) doesn\'t just send the line back up: it hooks whatever it hit. If it was a fish\'s head, that fish is on your line, even a heavy one. And it\'s the only way to land rocks, driftwood and jellies, which are worth big points (%2$s base points, multiplied the deeper you go). Aim your last bump at something good!
Pass through %1$d fish heads in the bump-free first %2$d m of one cast. They don\'t cost bumps up there.
Fish swim in schools. Land %1$d or more of the same species in a single cast.
Catch a fish shallower than %1$d m on the way up, right before you land.
Don\'t touch the screen for a whole cast, and still land %1$d or more fish.
Use all %1$d bumps within %2$d seconds by steering into a cluster.
A fish you bumped on the way down hasn\'t gone far. Catch it by the head on the way up and it\'s worth double.
Reach the end of a rope of at least %1$d m without a single bump.
Make your last bump snag an object within %1$d m of the end of your rope.
In a timed battle, start a cast with under %1$d seconds on the clock and still land a fish.
On the way up, hook a fish by the head right as it turns around at the edge of the water (within %1$s s).
Make your %1$d bumps hit four different things: a fish\'s head, a rock, driftwood and a jelly. They only share the water between about %2$d and %3$d m.
Make your last bump hook a Sparkling fish by the head, on the way down.
On the way up, catch %1$d or more fish in strictly increasing weight. Deep fish tend to be heavy, so pick your catches.
Surface with your line exactly at its weight limit, with at least %1$d catches, and the fish that fills it weighing %2$s kg or more. Leave just the right room!
Below %1$d m and without a Lantern, catch a fish that glows on the way up, aiming only by its light.
Win Best of 5 against the Hard rival without dropping a round (3-0).
Bump a fish on the way down (it darts away for a moment), then hook it by the head on the way up while it is still fleeing. Tip: make that your last bump, so the hook turns back right away.
Without a Lantern, drop to at least %1$d m and reach the end of your rope without a single bump.
Land a fish from every depth zone (%1$s) in a single cast.
In one cast, snag an object with your last bump and catch %1$d or more fish on the way up.
On the way up, hook two fish by the head at the very same instant.
Once your line can\'t take another fish, don\'t reel in fast: brush past %1$d different fish on the way up. Any part of a fish counts.
Hook the %1$s with your last bump while your rope is too weak to carry it. A legendary catch.
Everything in one cast: your last bump snags an object within %1$d m of the end of your rope, you catch a Sparkling fish on the way up, and you surface with a perfect load.
Fill the whole fish log: all %1$d species, including the one that lives at the very bottom and only the last bump can land.
The hooked object or fish is yours.
